caption:
A professor, a candy workshop and one secret ingredient. 🍬✨

This looks straight out of an animated movie.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Premium stylized 3D animated feature-film look, ultra-detailed soft materials, warm golden sunlight streaming through tall windows, volumetric light rays and floating sugar dust, soft bloom, rich warm pastel palette of honey gold, copper, cream, strawberry pink and rainbow pastels, shallow depth of field. Camera feel: buttery-smooth and weightless, FPV glide, dolly push-ins, slow-motion macro moments. Pacing: playful and wondrous, building to a grand reveal. No on-screen text, no title card, no logos, no subtitles.

CHARACTERS:
- THE PROFESSOR: a thin, lively old inventor, light skin, long face with a big round pink nose and wide grin, huge wild frizzy grey-white hair sticking out in all directions, large round black-rimmed goggle-glasses that magnify big warm amber eyes, knee-length white lab coat over a teal-grey waistcoat with a small sparkly pattern, dark trousers, skinny legs. Signature: the wild grey hair and the round goggles in every shot.
- THE ASSISTANT: a tall, pale, chalk-white-faced helper with neat combed white hair, small round wire glasses, big round eyes, white lab coat.
- THE HELPERS: two tiny gnome-sized assistants in white lab coats and round glasses.
- MOCHI: a round, glowing, cream-white marshmallow blob with a simple happy face, floating, carrying a huge white cloth sack of sparkling flour.
- JELLO: a glossy translucent strawberry-pink jelly blob with big round eyes and a small puckered mouth, wobbly.
- SPRINKLE: a tiny glowing winged fairy with pale shimmering wings.

LOCATION: an enormous cathedral-like candy workshop: towering gothic arched windows, a giant art-nouveau stained-glass window of curving pastel pink, yellow, teal and lilac panes, warm wooden floors and wooden bridges, gleaming copper pipes, kettles, stills and stand mixers, shelves stacked to the ceiling with giant cupcakes, cookies, strawberries and jars, floating cupcakes and a golden chandelier, flowering vines with glowing strawberries, and in the centre a big ornate golden mixing bowl on a pedestal.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:02.3) — Fly-in. FPV drone shot starting tight on the giant pastel stained-glass window, gliding straight through its warm glowing panes into the huge workshop, then soaring forward and slightly down over wooden bridges, copper pipes, floating cupcakes and tiny helpers crossing below, slowing as the professor appears at the centre of the room. MUST SHOW: the art-nouveau stained-glass window at the start.
SHOT 2 (00:02.3-00:02.5) — Two very quick flash cuts of the workshop floor and vines with glowing strawberries.
SHOT 3 (00:02.5-00:05.8) — The professor. Medium-wide, eye level, slow dolly push-in: the professor stands in the centre beside the golden bowl holding up a large clear glass sheet with a sketched recipe; Mochi floats at upper left under its huge white flour sack; the helpers stand at the sides. The camera keeps pushing in to a medium shot as he sets the glass aside and raises a small glowing golden spoon that sheds a trail of golden sparkles, then to an extreme close-up of his face, goggles glinting, amber eyes sparkling, warm smile. MUST SHOW: the glowing golden spoon trailing sparkles.
SHOT 4 (00:05.8-00:07.3) — Ingredients. Close-up, slow orbit around the golden bowl, slightly high angle: a white sack tips a stream of glowing red berries into it, then a white waterfall of sparkling flour, while a copper kettle pours a shimmering clear stream; Sprinkle hovers above; the batter inside swirls into pastel rainbow colours.
SHOT 5 (00:07.3-00:07.7) — Reaction. Close two-shot: the assistant at left, wide-eyed and stunned, the professor at right laughing with joy.
SHOT 6 (00:07.7-00:09.9) — Rainbow magic. Extreme slow-motion close-up in mid-air: glossy ribbons of rainbow-striped batter loop and spiral through the air, strawberries, mini cupcakes and a white sugar butterfly float among golden sparkles; the camera drifts and settles on Jello in the middle of the swirling ribbons, eyes wide, whistling innocently. MUST SHOW: thick glossy rainbow-striped batter ribbons looping in the air, and Jello framed among them.
SHOT 7 (00:09.9-00:15.1) — The dessert. Wide, low angle from behind a foreground of giant cupcakes, strawberries and cookies, slow push-in and gentle crane up: above the golden bowl in the centre of the workshop floats a giant glowing pastel-rainbow flower-shaped dessert, slowly blossoming open like a lotus, a soft golden beam of light glowing down into the bowl; the professor, the assistant, the helpers, Mochi and Jello stand around below gazing up; sunbeams pour through the tall windows. Hold on this wide view to the end. MUST SHOW: the huge blooming rainbow flower dessert floating above the bowl.

SOUND: playful whimsical orchestral score (pizzicato strings, glockenspiel, woodwinds) building to a magical swell at the reveal and ending on an uplifting chord. Whoosh of the fly-in, gentle humming of machines, clinking glass, sparkle chimes on the spoon, pouring berries and flour, bubbling batter, a giggle from Jello, the professor's delighted laugh. Professor, warm and excited in Shot 3: "Now then... let's discover something impossible." Professor, softly over Shot 7: "Perfection is delicious... but surprises are unforgettable."
prompt_short: 3D animated feature style, 16:9: a wild-haired inventor in a giant golden candy workshop raises a glowing spoon; berries, flour and rainbow batter swirl in slow motion around a pink jelly blob, and a huge rainbow flower dessert blooms overhead.
